1.web: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
1.asv: And the princes of the people dwelt in Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in theothercities.

2.web: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
2.asv: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

3.web: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
3.asv: Now these are the chiefs of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

4.web: In Jerusalem lived certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
4.asv: And in Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

5.web: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
5.asv: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

6.web: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
6.asv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt in Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

7.web: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
7.asv: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

8.web: After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
8.asv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

9.web: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
9.asv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

10.web: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
10.asv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

11.web: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
11.asv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,

12.web: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
12.asv: and their brethren that did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty and two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

13.web: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
13.asv: and his brethren, chiefs of fathers’houses, two hundred forty and two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

14.web: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
14.asv: and their brethren, mighty men of valor, a hundred twenty and eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

15.web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
15.asv: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

16.web: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
16.asv: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God;

17.web: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
17.asv: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

18.web: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
18.asv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.

19.web: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
19.asv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren, that kept watch at the gates, were a hundred seventy and two.

20.web: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
20.asv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

21.web: But the Nethinim lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
21.asv: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.

22.web: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
22.asv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of the house of God.

23.web: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
23.asv: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

24.web: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
24.asv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

25.web: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, and in Dibon and its towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
25.asv: And as for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt in Kiriath-arba and the towns thereof, and in Dibon and the towns thereof, and in Jekabzeel and the villages thereof,

26.web: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth Pelet,
26.asv: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth-pelet,

27.web: and in Hazar Shual, and in Beersheba and its towns,
27.asv: and in Hazar-shual, and in Beer-sheba and the towns thereof,

28.web: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in its towns,
28.asv: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in the towns thereof,

29.web: and in En Rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,
29.asv: and in En-rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,

30.web: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
30.asv: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and the fields thereof, Azekah and the towns thereof. So they encamped from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

31.web: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
31.asv: The children of Benjamin also dwelt from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Beth-el and the towns thereof,

35.web: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
35.asv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

36.web: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
36.asv: And of the Levites, certain courses in Judah were joined to Benjamin.
